Rohan: quick partner hit — their CI broke after key rotation because docs/samples mix RW_TOKEN, REDWOOD_KEY, and REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE. Super confusing.
Tessa: oof. which places?
Rohan: examples/chat/README.md shows RW_TOKEN, infra/docker/Dockerfile uses REDWOOD_KEY, and a demo app mounts REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE.
Miguel: we need a single canonical + a clear alias map. Proposal: canonical REDWOOD_API_KEY (string) + REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE (path) + REDWOOD_CREDENTIALS_FILE (JSON envelope). Short scoping vars: REDWOOD_ORG and REDWOOD_PROJECT.
Tessa: agree. For SDKs: add a shared env-normalizer helper that checks canonical and legacy aliases, prefers file > env > credentials_file, and emits a one-line migration hint if legacy found (opt-out with REDWOOD_SILENCE_ENV_WARN=true).
Miguel: also SDK parity: tokenProvider(fn) in all languages and a normalized AuthError type with fields: message, code, retryable. Map 401/403 -> retryable=false, 429 -> retryable=true. That will make caller retries deterministic.
Rohan: CLI change: `rw auth login --format=json` should output machine JSON like:
```json
{"token":"sk_live_...","expiry":"2026-10-01T12:00:00Z","source":"cli"}
```
and print shell-safe snippets for bash/pwsh/fish separately with an explicit warning: "Do not commit tokens."
Tessa: small UX: when both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE exist, prefer file and log debug. In CI (REDWOOD_CI=true) fail fast to avoid ambiguity.
Miguel: implement env-normalizer in node/python first, then port to Go/Rust. Include tests that simulate rotation and check that tokenProvider is invoked after a 401.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs PR updating quickstart envs is open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/314
security-bot: Org "partner-beta" scheduled rotation 2026-11-05T00:00:00Z. Contact security for freeze windows.
Rohan: action items: I'll replace legacy var mentions in sample READMEs and add a migration section.
Tessa: I'll build the env-normalizer lib (node + python) and add the opt-out flag.
Miguel: I'll file SDK parity issues for Go/Rust and draft the AuthError shape and tests.
Rohan: one more note — add a lint in docs CI that fails on legacy var names or inline token examples. That will prevent regressions.
Tessa: sounds good. tagging @devex and @sdk-maintainers. Will post PRs here as they land. :thumbsup:
